title: Bolan University Of Medical and Health Sciences Amendment Act 2020

sections.shortTitle: Bolan University Of Medical and Health Sciences Amendment Act 2020
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VI OF 2020
ACT VI OF 2020
BOLAN UNIVERSITY OF MEDICAL AND HEALTH
SCIENCES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020
An Act to further amend the Bolan University of
Medical
and Health Sciences Act, 2017 (Act No. VII of 2017)
[Gazette of Balochistan Extraordinary,
3rd November, 2020]
No.
PAB / Legis; V(09) / 2020, dated 3.11.2020.---The Balochistan University of Medical and Health Sciences (Amendment)
Bill, 2020 (Bill No. 09 of 2020), having been passed by the Provincial Assembly
of Balochistan on 26th October, 2020 and assented to by the Governor,
Balochistan on 03rd November, 2020 is hereby published as an Act of the
Balochistan Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---WHEREAS, it is expedient to further amend the
Bolan University of Medical and Health Sciences Act, 2017 (Act No. VII of
2017), in the manner hereinafter appearing;
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Bolan University of Medical and Health Sciences
(Amendment) Act, 2020.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

of Balochistan on 26th October, 2020 and assented to by the Governor,

Balochistan Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---WHEREAS, it is expedient to further amend the
Bolan University of Medical and Health Sciences Act, 2017 (Act No. VII of
2017), in the manner hereinafter appearing;
2. Amendment
of Section 3, Act VII of 2017.---In
the Bolan University of Medical and Health Sciences Act, 2017 (Act VII of
2017), hereafter referred to as the said Act in Section 3, for subsections (2),
(3) and (4), the following shall be substituted:-
"(2)
Loralai Medical College Loralai and Jhalawan Medical College Khuzdar shall be
the constituent colleges, the Bolan Medical College and its Dental Section
Shall be the constituent College of University for the period of two (2) years
only.
(3)
Any teaching institution, medical college, dental college, nursing schools or
colleges, paramedical schools or colleges may be affiliated with University as
may be prescribed by the Government.
(4)
The teaching hospitals of Loralai Medical College Loralai and Jhalawan Medical
College Khuzdar shall be the attached hospitals of the University and the Bolan
Medical Complex hospital shall be the attached hospital of the University for
the period of two years."

Preamble.---WHEREAS, it is expedient to further amend the
Bolan University of Medical and Health Sciences Act, 2017 (Act No. VII of
2017), in the manner hereinafter appearing;
3. Amendment
of Section 4, Act VII of 2017.---In
the said Act, for Section 4, the following shall be substituted:-
(1) All
properties, rights and interests of whatever kind used, enjoyed, possessed,
owned or vested in or held in by the University shall be in ownership of the
Government.
(2) All
employees serving in Bolan Medical College and its Dental Section and Loralai
Medical College Loralai and Jhalawan Medical College Khuzdar in any capacity
shall remain Civil Servants and their services shall be governed under
Balochistan Civil Servants Act 1974 (Act No. IX of 1974) and the Rules framed
there under.

Bolan University of Medical and Health Sciences Act, 2017 (Act No. VII of
2017), in the manner hereinafter appearing;
6. Amendment
of Section 38, Act VII of 2017.---In
the said Act, for section 38, the following shall be substituted:-
"(1)
There shall be established a university fund to which shall be credited grants
received from the federal and provincial government and income from fees,
charges donations, trusts, bequest, endowments, contributions and grant-in aid
from any source.
(2)
The funds shall be kept in such custody, form and manner as may be determined
by the Authority of the University".
